clue.text: Bone put in pile on the way out

indicators.note: put in tells us one piece is placed inside the other, the bone going into the pile

parts.note: a mound is a heap or pile
a rib is a bone of the chest

explanation.surface: Someone discarding a bone onto a heap of rubbish as they leave.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on the way out' looks like part of the scene but is the definition: dying or in terminal decline.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: something dying or in terminal decline is on its way out.
An informal adverb meaning extremely, and an adjective meaning powerful.

clue.text: Sense a boy overcome by extremes of rage

indicators.note: in a down answer, being overcome means sitting beneath, so the boy comes after
extremes of means the outermost letters of the word are taken

parts.note: a son is a boy

explanation.surface: A lad's good sense is overwhelmed by fury.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: good sense or sanity, as in losing one's mind.

clue.text: Sound of lift in UK resort

indicators.note: sound of says we want a word that is spoken like the synonym for lift

parts.note: to brighten is to lift, as of a mood

explanation.surface: The noise of an elevator in a British seaside town.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lift' looks like the British word for an elevator but means cheer up.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a seaside town on England's south coast.

parts.note: no means none, an absence of something
US stands for the United States

explanation.surface: A jibe that Americans lack common sense.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface reads as an insult; the clue simply splits into 'no' and 'US'.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a British informal word, from Greek, for practical intelligence.

indicators.note: chaining suggests the old Dutchmen surround and hold the ten within them

parts.note: the Boers were Dutch settlers in southern Africa
X is the Roman numeral for ten

explanation.surface: Dutch colonists of old keeping ten dogs on chains.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: the boxer is a breed of dog, so these are dogs of that breed.

indicators.note: couple means a pair, so the abbreviation for old is written twice

parts.note: to long is to yearn

explanation.surface: An elderly pair longing for a cup of tea.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a Chinese partly fermented tea.

indicators.note: welcoming means letting in, so the figure holds the other piece

parts.note: eight is a figure, a number
yes, like fine, signals agreement

explanation.surface: A number embracing a fine academic department.
explanation.walkthrough: 'faculty' suggests a university department, but here it is a bodily power.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: one of the senses, a faculty of the body.

parts.note: to see is to grasp or understand
a thing is an object

explanation.surface: An angry person seizing an item.
explanation.walkthrough: 'grasp' and 'object' look physical; they mean understand and a thing.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: boiling with anger.
Synonym for courteous, and an exclamation of surprise as in 'Good gracious!'.

definitions.meaning: the woolly coat of a sheep, an animal or beast

explanation.definitionFit: Both a verb meaning to swindle and the woolly covering of a sheep; 'beastly' plays on beasts.

clue.text: One of thirteen in band, I am on drums

indicators.note: in shows the letters are found inside the words that follow

explanation.surface: A musician in a group announcing they play drums.
explanation.walkthrough: 'thirteen' suggests a band line-up, but it is the thirteen cards in a suit.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a pack holds thirteen cards of this red suit.

parts.note: too means also
thy is the old form of your or yours

explanation.surface: Someone noting that some grins look like theirs, and yours too.
explanation.walkthrough: THY is the archaic second-person possessive, used in old prayers and poetry.
explanation.definitionFit: Description: a broad grin showing many teeth is called this.

indicators.note: building means the letters of the next word are constructed into a new shape

explanation.surface: A complex of buildings has been completed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Complex' reads as a noun (a building complex) but is the adjective definition; 'building' signals rearranging the letters of 'finished'.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a fiendishly hard puzzle is very complicated or intricate.

indicators.note: working means the letters are worked into a different form

explanation.surface: A craftsman labouring for the Russian ruler.
explanation.definitionFit: Title: the wife of a tsar, or a female ruler of Russia.

indicators.note: getting in signals that the problem goes inside the shape

parts.note: a cone is a geometrical shape
a sum is an arithmetic problem

explanation.surface: A dieter told that struggling to get fit is no reason not to eat.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to eat or devour food is to take it in.

clue.text: Fragile thing cut somewhere on the face

indicators.note: cut means the word is shortened by its final letter

parts.note: china, fine porcelain, is easily broken

explanation.surface: A fragile object has caused a cut on someone's face.
explanation.definitionFit: Description: the jaw's front point lies on the lower part of the face.

clue.text: Fly low around capital in Sweden, then leave

indicators.note: around tells us the cow's noise surrounds what follows

parts.note: to low is to moo, the sound of cattle

indicators.note: then joins the two pieces in order
capital in means the capital or first letter of the word

parts.note: to quit is to leave

explanation.surface: Instructions to fly low over Stockholm and then go.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fly' looks like a verb; 'capital' suggests a city but picks the capital letter S.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a biting insect, a kind of fly.

indicators.note: bottles means holds in, so the soup encloses the small word

parts.note: potage is a thick soup

explanation.surface: Wine in the soup is bottled up.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a red grape variety and wine from South Africa.

clue.text: Novel retains minimum of respect — there are holes in it

indicators.note: novel means new, so the letters take a new order
minimum of means the smallest part, just the first letter of the word

explanation.surface: A book keeping barely any respect, though full of holes.
explanation.definitionFit: Description: a sieve or colander is full of holes for draining.

clue.text: State I love, well to the west

indicators.note: in an across answer the west is the left, so the well goes in front

parts.note: oh, like well, is an interjection
love is zero in tennis, shaped like the letter O

explanation.surface: Someone declaring affection for a US state lying to the west.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to the west' tempts a reversal, but it only moves 'well' (OH) to the front of I and O.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: this is one of the fifty states of the USA.

indicators.note: rocks means shakes up, so the letters of the next word are disturbed

explanation.surface: A stone ripping through rocks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rocks' sits naturally beside 'Stone' but is the signal to rearrange 'tearing'.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a hard igneous rock used in building and worktops.

clue.text: Item used by trumpeter to keep in time

indicators.note: to keep means to hold, so the item encloses the small word

parts.note: a mute is a device a trumpeter uses to soften the sound

explanation.surface: A trumpeter's gadget used for keeping time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'keep in time' reads as music, but splits into 'keep', 'in' and the definition 'time'.
explanation.definitionFit: Unit of time: sixty seconds, or a short while.

clue.text: Stop and give a lift to storyteller and journalist

indicators.note: in a down answer, giving a lift raises the pieces so they read upwards

parts.note: a liar tells stories, untruths
ED is short for editor, a journalist

explanation.surface: A driver halting to offer a ride to a writer and a reporter.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to derail a plan is to stop or thwart it.

parts.note: in means fashionable or popular
a deed is a legal contract

explanation.surface: A well-liked agreement, certainly.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: certainly, truly, as an emphatic affirmation.

indicators.note: redistributed means the letters are handed out again in a fresh order

explanation.surface: A share of something that has not been quite fairly reallocated.
explanation.definitionFit: Mathematical sense: the result of a division, each part's portion when something is divided.

clue.text: A vet upset with service in pub

indicators.note: upset means overturned, so the letters of the two words are disordered

parts.note: RN, the Royal Navy, is known as the senior service in Britain

explanation.surface: An animal doctor annoyed by the service in a pub.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' acts on 'A vet' only, giving TAVE; the Royal Navy is Britain's 'senior service'.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: an inn or public house serving drinks.

parts.note: kip is British slang for a sleep

explanation.surface: Missing out on a second snooze.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to skip a class is to miss it.

clue.text: One with famous voice, not entirely tragic character

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

indicators.note: not entirely means the name is used without its full length, losing its last letter

parts.note: Enrico Caruso was a celebrated operatic tenor

explanation.surface: A famous singer who was only partly a tragic figure.
explanation.definitionFit: Myth: the youth who flew too near the sun on wax wings and fell to his death.

clue.text: Using face creams etc, risk acne unfortunately

indicators.note: unfortunately suggests things going wrong, so the letters fall out of order

explanation.surface: Applying face creams can, sadly, bring on spots.
explanation.definitionFit: Description: the routine of looking after one's complexion with creams and lotions.

definitions.meaning: in cricket, the skilled batsman who begins the innings
a tool that opens a lock

explanation.definitionFit: A cricketer who starts the batting, and a device that unlocks or unseals things.

clue.text: Taken around play area, toboggan was scintillating

indicators.note: taken around signals that the toboggan surrounds the play area

parts.note: a sled is a toboggan
a park is a place to play

explanation.surface: A toboggan carried round a playground, gleaming in the snow.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: something that glittered or shone brilliantly.
